item.title: MIT engineers bacteria into living circuits
item.description: Researchers at MIT have developed bacterial components that can be linked to form living circuits, capable of performing computations and guiding functions.

item.title: Fading radio galaxies surprise astronomers
item.description: Astronomers discovered that some radio galaxies dim faster than expected, as their central black holes cease activity sooner than previously thought.
